name: international-patient-summary-ui-with-svelte
description: Browser-only, read-only viewer for HL7 FHIR International Patient Summary documents (JSON or YAML), with JSON/YAML/Markdown/one-page PDF export, four locales, and a public backendless tour signing in as example@example.com.
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR OGL-UK-3.0 OR CC-BY-SA-4.0

Routes.name: /tour/
Routes.description: public backendless tour: sign in as example@example.com

Routes.name: /service/
Routes.description: sign in to the backend (OIDC with PKCE), store, list, open and delete summaries (spec §6.10); VITE_IPS_SERVICE_URL, VITE_IPS_OIDC_ISSUER, VITE_IPS_OIDC_CLIENT_ID

Modules.name: FHIR core
Modules.description: framework-free parsing, references, sections, absent states, formatting

Modules.name: Service contract
Modules.description: the backend API as IpsService; its IPS check and refusal codes

Modules.name: OIDC
Modules.description: authorization code flow with PKCE, no library; token in memory only

Modules.name: Service session
Modules.description: the tab's backend session behind /service/ and the viewer's Save to service

Modules.name: HTTP service
Modules.description: IpsService against the backend: bearer token, problems as ServiceError, paged list through next links (spec §6.9)

Modules.name: Tour session
Modules.description: demo sign-in, seeding, open, delete, sign-out

Modules.name: Viewer state
Modules.description: the open document, in memory only
